Repeat patterns, light and dark

Twelve repeats on one rule: evenly spaced, everything large and all one size, tone on tone. Eight are made from the brand's soft shapes. Four are outlines: the cast's heads, the app's line icons, both together, and the shapes in line. For each: light, then dark, then all six colours in both. Nothing is dark in light mode.
